tagline.en: Every story in the shortest, simplest words
tagline.hi: हर खबर, सबसे छोटे और आसान शब्दों में

adsense.about: Paste your AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-...) after Google approves the site. Slot ids come from AdSense > Ads > By ad unit. Empty = that ad spot is not shown.

gemini.about: Free Google Gemini settings. models: tried in order (each has its own free limit). batch: stories per request. perRun: most stories summarized in one run (every 30 minutes). topFirst: how many of them are simply the biggest stories; the rest are shared out so every group, state and district gets some. perFeed: most stories from one news feed in one run.
